pages.title: Arcane Wrench
pages.description: The Arcane Wrench is Create's Wrench augmented with Ars Nouveau magic. Obtain it by enchanting a Create Wrench in the Enchanting Apparatus.

Additional  capabilities:   - Rune blocks:  Right-click to  configure cooldown   - Relays:  Right-click to  convert a Relay into  a Precise Relay to  configure its  cooldown   - Pedestals,  Turrets, Containment  Jars: Sneak +
